Evidence: Civic Accountability, Mass Doxing Spree, Community Collapse
#CharlieKirk #FreeSpeech #Polarization

Advocates of exposure campaigns framed neighbor-on-neighbor doxing as grassroots moral justice, claiming public accountability is required to purge society of callous celebrations of political murder.

A year after activist Charlie Kirk was assassinated at Utah Valley University, crowd-sourced doxing campaigns like 'Expose Charlie's Murderers' have weaponized neighborly disputes into career-ending retaliation.

The Bright Side:
Legal experts, privacy groups, and civic organizations have begun building institutional defenses against decentralized doxing to preserve the right to private association.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The breakdown occurs on the Metaphysical Plane (Q1). Partisans claim community protection while actually operating a decentralized blacklist that strips away neighborly trust and security.

Social Physics Analysis:
The actors execute a classic smart selfish maneuver. By manufacturing an existential crusade out of genuine tragedy, outrage entrepreneurs motivate everyday citizens to project hostility onto neighbors, consolidating control.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Decentralized surveillance dissolves the social contract into mutual paranoia.

The Unavoidable Truth: Democratizing mob retribution turns ordinary disagreement into collective terror.
The Unavoidable Lie: Doxing neighbors protects community decency.
